description: Reads rows of an app table across all users (not their neblla.db.save() data): filter, order, page or count. Each row has id, owner (user id), createdAt, updatedAt. Read-only; neblla_table_row edits. More: neblla_get_llms tools/table_query

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

count.description: true: only the number of matching rows.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

owner.description: Only this user's rows; "g:<group>" for a group's.

table.description: A table declared in the app.

where.description: { field: value } or { field: { eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in } }; declared fields only.

name: neblla_table_query
title: Query a table
